cmdParamsKeys.description: patrol-cmd-params-cm keys with an effect in Patrol CD (generated from internal/settings by hack/helmdocs)

patrolCM.description: patrol-cm keys (generated from internal/settings by hack/helmdocs)

additionalUrls.description: YAML list of additional external URLs (SSO redirects)

application.allowedNodeLabels.description: comma-separated node labels shown in the pod view

application.instanceLabelKey.description: label used for label-based resource tracking (default app.kubernetes.io/instance)

application.links.description: YAML list of Application deep links

application.sync.impersonation.enabled.description: "true" syncs with project destination service accounts

application.sync.impersonation.enforced.description: "false" falls back to the controller service account

application.sync.requireOverridePrivileg.description: true requires the override action to sync another revision

exec.shells.description: comma-separated shells tried by the web terminal (default bash,sh,powershell,cmd)

extension.config.description: proxy extensions (YAML extensions list; $secret references allowed)

ga.trackingid.description: Google Analytics tracking ID used by the UI

globalProjects.description: YAML list of {projectName, labelSelector} global projects

helm.valuesFileSchemes.description: allowed URL schemes of remote Helm value files (default https, http)

help.chatText.description: text of the UI help chat button (default "Chat now!")

help.chatUrl.description: URL of the UI help chat button

installationID.description: installation ID written on managed resources

jsonnet.enable.description: anything but "true" disables Jsonnet in directory sources

oidc.tls.insecure.skip.verify.description: "true" skips TLS verification towards the OIDC provider

passwordPattern.description: regular expression new local passwords must match (default ^.{8,32}$)

project.links.description: YAML list of project deep links

resource.customLabels.description: comma-separated labels shown as resource info

resource.customizations.description: legacy YAML map of resource customizations

resource.excludeEventLabelKeys.description: comma-separated label key globs never copied onto Application events

resource.exclusions.description: YAML list of resource filters excluded from discovery

resource.includeEventLabelKeys.description: comma-separated label key globs copied onto Application events

resource.inclusions.description: YAML list of resource filters included in discovery

resource.links.description: YAML list of resource deep links

resource.respectRBAC.description: "", "normal" or "strict": skip APIs the controller cannot list

resource.sensitive.mask.annotations.description: comma-separated Secret annotation keys masked in diffs

server.maxPodLogsToRender.description: maximum pods whose logs the UI renders (default 10)

server.rbac.disableApplicationFineGraine.description: true (default): resource update/delete checks only fine-grained actions

statusbadge.url.description: root URL override for status badge links

timeout.reconciliation.jitter.description: maximum random delay added to periodic refreshes (default 60s)

ui.cssurl.description: URL or path of custom UI CSS

url.description: external URL of the API server and UI; required for SSO

users.anonymous.enabled.description: "true" lets unauthenticated users act with policy.default

webhook.refresh.jitter.threshold.description: affected applications before webhook jitter applies (default 10)

^kustomize\\.buildOptions\\..+$.description: build options of an additional Kustomize version

^kustomize\\.path\\..+$.description: binary path of an additional Kustomize version

^resource\\.customizations\\.(health|use.description: resource customization (health, actions, ignoreDifferences, ignoreResourceUpdates, knownTypeFields, useOpenLibs)

patrolRBACCM.description: patrol-rbac-cm keys (generated from internal/settings by hack/helmdocs)

scopes.description: YAML list of OIDC claims evaluated as groups (default [groups])

^policy\\..+\\.csv$.description: policy overlays appended in key order
